fields.description: Oria is a 163-home apartment development beside the Creek Beach district of Dubai Creek Harbour. One to three bedroom layouts sit above a shared leisure podium, with shaded balconies and outlooks towards the park, canal or surrounding city. Its larger apartments occupy different floor bands, making the exact plan and orientation important parts of choosing a home.

research.community: Dubai Creek Harbour · beside Creek Beach
overview: The podium brings the everyday facilities together: pools, gym spaces, a multipurpose room and gardens for quieter recreation. The building’s design uses shaded balconies and tinted glazing to manage glare. Its brochure also describes insulated roofs, double glazing, LED controls, condensate reuse and EV charging. These are published design specifications; confirm the final specification and access arrangements for the chosen apartment.
research.locationNote: Oria is beside Creek Beach, with the waterfront promenade, Creek Marina, Central Park and the Viewing Point identified as nearby destinations. Park, canal and skyline views vary by unit. Developer references to metro and water transport should be checked against current routes and opening dates rather than assumed operational.
research.priceNote: The official page states AED 1.7m. The February 2024 fact sheet gives starting prices of AED 1.7m, 2.7m and 3.7m for one, two and three bedrooms respectively. Those launch figures are not confirmation of stock or a current offer; request a dated unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan places 90% before estimated completion and 10% at completion. It includes a 15% stage in December 2025 and a 5% stage in April 2026; the other stages are 10% each. Past dates are historical obligations, so any new purchase needs an updated balance and payment schedule.
research.handoverNote: The project payment and fact sheets estimate completion in July 2028. Property Finder instead displays December 2025, which conflicts with those documents. July 2028 is retained as an attributed launch estimate; obtain written confirmation of the current contractual programme.

facts.label: Collection size
facts.value: The launch fact sheet lists 163 apartments. This is the development’s launch total, not the number currently offered for sale.

facts.label: Podium-area discrepancy
facts.value: The official brochure and launch fact sheet describe 3,600 sq m of amenities podium, whereas the current Emaar page states 6,000 sq m. Facilities are listed consistently, but the area requires developer clarification.

facts.label: Understanding the plan totals
facts.value: Total area includes suite and balcony space. The two-bedroom podium unit 03 is 1,309.86 sq ft, including 145.10 sq ft of balcony; podium unit 04 is 1,222.46 sq ft with a 51.88 sq ft balcony. Similar bedroom counts do not imply identical layouts.

facts.label: Higher-floor homes
facts.value: The three-bedroom drawings cover levels 13–20 and range from the 1,658.93 sq ft Type B to the 1,726.75 sq ft Type A. Check the exact unit’s orientation, balcony and approved area schedule.
